# launch.config_dir cases: one per line,
# "accept " or "refuse " and the value, to the end of the line. This file is
# identical in d1-ee-sdk (crates/d1fw-ee-manifest/tests/fixtures/rules/) and
# d1-provisioning (tests/fixtures/ee-manifest-rules/): the SDK's validator
# and the on-robot reader are held to the same verdicts.
accept /etc/d1-ee-ag
accept /etc/d1-firmwared/ee-provider
accept /etc/d1-firmwared/config.d-extra
accept /etc/acme/g1+2/v1.0_x
refuse /etc/d1-firmwared/config.d
refuse /etc/d1-firmwared/config.d/ag
refuse /etc/systemd
refuse /etc/systemd/system
refuse /etc/systemd-ee
refuse /etc/apt
refuse /etc/apt/sources.list.d
refuse /etc/apt-ee
refuse /etc
refuse /etc/
refuse /etc/d1-ee-ag/
refuse /etc//d1-ee-ag
refuse /etc/../tmp
refuse /etc/./d1-ee-ag
refuse /etc/.d1-ee-ag
refuse /etc/d1-ee-ag/{side}
refuse /opt/d1-ee-ag/etc
refuse /var/lib/d1-ee-ag
refuse etc/d1-ee-ag
refuse /etc/d1 ee ag
